prompt:
A full-body character image, vertical 2:3 (1024×1536): Diaochan of the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the peerless beauty whose chain stratagem turned Dong Zhuo and Lü Bu against each other.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face.
Face — her own, recognisably this character, a woman's face with no beard or facial hair: an elegant, refined presence; porcelain-pale skin; oval face; large eyes — soft droopy eyes, outer eye corners drooping downward; thin arched brows; small button nose; full heart-shaped lips; pale violet eyes; a small beauty mark under one eye.
Body and hair: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist build; an updo bun with blunt straight bangs; royal-purple hair.
Expression: softly lidded eyes, lips relaxed, subtle and relaxed.
Legend, carried in her design and bearing: a beauty before whom the moon hid behind the clouds, a dancer of the palace, the linked-rings stratagem, silk ribbons and moonlight, quiet courage behind grace.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME AND EQUIPMENT — MECHA
Costume: a female mecha personification built as a support and logistics mecha frame — lighter plating, data panels and shield units, utility sub-arms. Solid hard-surface plates with visible joints cover her frame except at the openings named under Exposure; any cape or skirt is made of rigid armored plates; her face and hair stay human.
Silhouette: a long coat made of rigid plates from the shoulders to below the knees, open at the front to show the body armor, with an angular collar. This silhouette sets the overall shape of the costume above — keep its materials, ornaments and rank in this shape; the details are free.
Colours: soft pastel pink, blush rose, ivory white and pale rose gold, with small lilac accents. Faction frame: soft pastel-pink and ivory-white plating with pale rose-gold edges, sleek graceful dancer's frame with ribbon-like binder fins, small lilac accents, soft pink glow lines.
Signature item: a folding silk dance fan, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette — hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour. She holds it at full scale: one whole object, drawn once, held in front of or beside her body; a long weapon keeps one straight, unbroken shaft with a single head or blade.
Exposure (bold): her mecha frame is cut open by design in only these places — a deep open chest window with natural cleavage framed by the chest plates, and a bare waist and midriff between the bust plate and the hip armor; everywhere else she stays fully plated. The plates stay on, fitted and symmetrical, with skin clearly showing in each opening. Intimate areas covered; keep the plate material and palette.

4. SCENE
World: year 2190, the Free Zones — a lawless asteroid belt between the three powers: warlord fortresses carved into asteroids, wrecked starships drifting in the dark, a violet nebula, warning lights blinking.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: her whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet inside the frame with clear margins, about four-fifths of the image height; camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only — no second character, horse or other creature. No readable text or numbers — emblems are abstract insignia shapes only, never letters or Chinese characters. No logo, watermark, speech bubble or frame border. A far-future setting only — space stations, starships and high-tech structures — with no traditional East-Asian architecture.
Avoid: a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.

observations: One adult woman; full figure and both feet inside frame.
Two arms and two legs naturally connected; hands hold one dance fan.
Ribbon-like trailing elements appear fabric-like rather than rigid; openings extend beyond the two prescribed areas. Kept without regeneration.
limitations: Painterly brushwork appears subtler than specified.

acceptance: user authorized registration and normal main push after selection
